span.p:
Presentation Layer
[Flutter · go_router · flutter_bloc]
Screens & widgets driven by feature
Cubits/Blocs. Localized EN/AR,
theming via ThemeExtensions

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Feature Data Layer
[Dart · repositories + datasources]
Repositories map exceptions to
Failures and return Result<T>;
datasources build request models

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local Storage
[shared_preferences · AppManager]
Persists apiKey, uid, email,
name, locale — auth state =
presence of apiKey

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Notification Service
[firebase_messaging + local]
Handles foreground/background
FCM & local notifications

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Location & Timezone
[geolocator + timezone]
LocationProvider + TimezoneManager
detect country and set
the working timezone

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Networking
[Dio · DioConsumer / ApiConsumer]
Wraps payloads in a {params} envelope,
injects Bearer key + lang header,
maps errors to typed exceptions

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dependency Injection
[get_it · injection_container]
datasources/repos as singletons,
cubits/blocs as factories

Odoo JSON-RPC API
